nodes.label: Alert Rule Evaluation & Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Combines single-reading immediate checks with rolling time-window aggregations and unique active incident constraint.

nodes.label: Deterministic Deduplication Key
nodes.rationale: DeduplicationKey = rule:{ruleID}:sensor:{sensorID} prevents alert spam while status is OPEN or ACKNOWLEDGED.

nodes.label: High-Throughput Ingestion Engine
nodes.rationale: Decouples burst ingestion from alert evaluation using bounded channels and bulk write paths.

nodes.label: pgx.CopyFrom Bulk Binary Streaming
nodes.rationale: Bypasses individual INSERT statement overhead by streaming binary rows directly into PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: CampusPulse Architecture & System Design
nodes.rationale: Engineered as a modular, high-throughput IoT telemetry and incident command system for collegiate environments.

nodes.label: Dual Persistence Strategy
nodes.rationale: Zero-panic fallback to high-fidelity in-memory store when DATABASE_URL is unset; streams via pgx.CopyFrom when PostgreSQL is configured.

nodes.label: Incident Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: OPEN -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> RESOLVED (with root cause note) -> REOPEN.

nodes.label: 10K Burst Benchmark & Load Test Report
nodes.rationale: Validates durability and throughput under 10,000 burst reading scenarios with zero failures.
